title: Burmese Refugees in Thailand Face Fresh Deportation Threat
gist: Burmese refugees in Thailand face a renewed deportation threat; the piece profiles Nway, a 23-year-old activist released from prison in April 2026 who fled forced conscription by Myanmar's junta, which controls only about 20 percent of the country and has conscripted over 30,000 since February 2024.

themes.theme: Myanmar junta weakness and refugee pressure

insights.speaker: Alex Howlett
insights.so_what: A severely weakened junta implies prolonged conflict, border instability and outflows into Thailand.
